source: Rehman and Baart draft9January2004, wordlist water and tone discussion; printed page inspected
basis: Source has low first long syllable and acute on first i of final ii; DB pā̌nī̂ incorrectly turns the initial Low into a rising contour. Final syllable carries the early High/falling accent. Preserve preceding low pitch separately, not as a second lexical contour.
These five lexemes are explicitly placed in the toneless class. This override does not extend to the many unmarked lexical tokens whose tone Hultman says is uncertain.
